As Buckeye Partners LP Partnership Shares (BPL) Market Value Declined, Shareholder Trust Asset Management Raised Stake; Fulton Bank Increases Holding in Celgene (CELG)
June 20, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Trust Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Buckeye Partners Lp Partnership Shares (BPL) by 11.14% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trust Asset Management Llc bought 39,363 shares as the company’s stock declined 22.07% with the market. The institutional investor held 392,785 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $14.61M, up from 353,422 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trust Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Buckeye Partners Lp Partnership Shares for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.55 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.47% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $36.22. About 589,301 shares traded. Buckeye Partners, L.P. (NYSE:BPL) has declined 45.65% since June 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 58.22% the S&P500.
